name: Lady Lucky Gun

features.name: Expanding wilds
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 expand to cover the reel.

features.name: Wild respins
features.description: Each wild triggers a respin, up to three in a row.

review:
A 20-line western classic built on expanding wilds and respins. Any wild on reels 2 to 4 expands to fill its reel, and you win if that makes a line.

Every wild also gives you a respin, and another wild during the respin gives another – up to three in a row. Expect frequent, modest wins: medium volatility, a 1,000x cap and 96.13% RTP. Same game as Miss Cherry Fruits with a gunslinger theme.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
